The software product **Loom** at the domain **loom.com** is directly provided by **Loom, Inc.** (an Atlassian subsidiary).

### Provider Evidence
* **Loom Terms of Service:** *"These Terms of Service (“Terms”) govern access to and use of the Services made available by Loom, Inc."*
* **Atlassian Product-Specific Terms:** *"“Loom” means the software-as-a-service solution (including the corresponding mobile, desktop or other applications) currently branded as “Loom” and made available by Loom, Inc."*
* **Website Notices (loom.com):** *"© 2026, Loom, Inc. All Rights Reserved."*
